# Aiva Wellness

> Aiva Wellness is an Indian nutraceutical company offering premium health and wellness supplements focused on heart health, immunity, bone health, and everyday nutrition.

Aiva Wellness is committed to providing high-quality dietary supplements manufactured to international quality standards. Our products are designed to support healthier lifestyles through science-backed nutrition.

## Company Information

- **Company:** Aiva Wellness
- **Website:** https://aivawellness.in
- **Industry:** Nutraceuticals & Dietary Supplements
- **Country:** India
- **Email:** info@aivawellness.in

## Products

- Vitamin D3 – Supports bone, muscle, and immune health.
- Omega-3 Fish Oil – Supports heart, brain, and joint health.
- Nattokinase 100 mg – Supports healthy blood circulation and everyday cardiovascular wellness.
- Nattokinase 200 mg – Delivers high-potency enzyme support for healthy blood circulation and cardiovascular wellness.
- Magnesium Complex 5-in-1 – Supports bone strength, muscle recovery, restful sleep, and everyday energy.
- Daily Vitals – Supports daily energy, immunity, and overall wellness with essential vitamins and minerals.
- Daily Vitals for Men 40+ – Supports men's everyday energy, immunity, and overall vitality.
- Daily Vitals for Women 40+ – Supports women's bone strength, energy, immunity, and overall vitality after 40.
